questions.question: Choose the correct form: "If I ___ rich, I would travel the world."
questions.explanation: Type 2 (unreal present): If + past (were), would + base verb.

questions.question: Choose the correct form: "She said that she ___ the work the previous day."
questions.explanation: In reported speech, the past moves back to the past perfect.

questions.question: Choose the correct form: "By 2030, we ___ the project."
questions.explanation: "By" a future time takes the future perfect.

questions.question: Choose the correct word: "I have been working here ___ 2019."
questions.explanation: "Since" is used with a starting point of time.

questions.question: Choose the correct form: "Hardly ___ he reached when it started to rain."
questions.explanation: Hardly is followed by the past perfect: Hardly had he reached when…

questions.question: Choose the correct form: "The train ___ before we reached the station."
questions.explanation: Leaving came before reaching, so the past perfect is used.

questions.question: Choose the correct form: "If it ___ tomorrow, we will cancel the trip."
questions.explanation: Type 1: the if-clause takes the simple present.

questions.question: Choose the correct form: "If I had known, I ___ you."
questions.explanation: Type 3: if + past perfect, would have + V3.

questions.question: Choose the correct form: "She asked me where I ___."
questions.explanation: In a reported question the verb moves back: lived.

questions.question: Report: He said, "I am busy." He said that he ___ busy.
questions.explanation: Present moves back to past: was.

questions.question: Choose the correct form: "I wish I ___ the answer."
questions.explanation: For an unreal present wish, use the past: knew.

questions.question: Choose the correct word: "No sooner had he left ___ it rained."
questions.explanation: No sooner is followed by than.

questions.question: Choose the correct form: "By the time you arrive, I ___ dinner."
questions.explanation: Completion before a future time: future perfect.

questions.question: Choose the correct form: "She ___ for two hours when he called."
questions.explanation: An action in progress up to a past moment: past perfect continuous.

questions.question: Choose the correct form: "If she ___ harder, she would have passed."
questions.explanation: Type 3: if + past perfect.

questions.question: Choose the correct form: "He suggested that she ___ a doctor."
questions.explanation: After suggest that, the base form (subjunctive) is used.

questions.question: Choose the correct form: "It is high time we ___ now."
questions.explanation: After "it is high time", the past form is used: left.

questions.question: Choose the correct form: "I would rather you ___ here tomorrow."
questions.explanation: After "would rather" with a different subject, use the past: stayed.

questions.question: Report: He said, "I will come tomorrow." He said that he ___ the next day.
questions.explanation: Will becomes would, and tomorrow becomes the next day.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.
options: I have lived here since five years.
I live here since five years.
I have lived here for five years.
I am living here from five years.
questions.explanation: "For" is used with a length of time, "since" with a starting point.
